privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.controllerBody: {{org}} runs this playbook. Questions about your data go to {{email}}.
privacy.controllerFallbackOrg: The organisation that hosts this playbook
privacy.controllerFallbackEmail: the contact address set by your organisation
privacy.whatWeProcessLead: Only what we need to run the playbook:

wp.admin: Admin emails (who can sign in, who invited whom). Passwords are handled by Supabase Auth and stored hashed — we never see them in plain text.
wp.session: One short sign-in cookie (qm_admin) with an admin flag and your email.
wp.ip: Failed sign-in IPs, kept in memory for about 15 minutes to slow brute-force attempts.
wp.confluence: If you connect Confluence: site name, account label, and an encrypted access token.
wp.content: Scenario text, categories, tags, and uploaded images that admins publish.

privacy.noEmployeeTracking: People who only read the playbook are not signed in and not tracked. No analytics, ads, or third-party scripts.

purpose.admin: So authorised people can edit the playbook.
purpose.security: So we can limit repeated failed sign-ins.
purpose.confluence: So linked Confluence pages can show inside a scenario.

privacy.legalBasisBody: We rely on legitimate interest to run and secure this workplace tool. Connecting Confluence is optional and based on your consent — disconnect any time in Admin.

retention.session: Sign-in cookie: up to 8 hours, or until you log out.
retention.content: Scenarios, categories, and images: until an admin deletes them (images are removed with the scenario).

sub.supabase: Supabase — database, image storage, and sign-in (DPA: supabase.com/legal/dpa).
sub.atlassian: Atlassian — only if Confluence is connected (DPA: atlassian.com/legal/data-processing-addendum).

privacy.transfersBody: Prefer EU regions for Supabase and Render so data stays in the EEA. Transfers outside use the standard contractual clauses in those DPAs.
privacy.cookiesBody: We set one cookie (qm_admin) after admin sign-in. Readers never get a cookie. No tracking or ads. That cookie is needed for sign-in, so a consent banner is not required — the small notice is just information.

sec.https: Production traffic uses HTTPS with HSTS.
sec.encRest: Supabase encrypts the database and file storage at rest.
sec.encTokens: Confluence tokens are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before storage.
sec.access: Only invited admins can sign in. Sessions use an httpOnly SameSite cookie.

privacy.rightsBody: Under the GDPR you can ask to:

rights.access: See what we hold about you.
rights.erase: Delete data (we will say if a legal reason blocks that for a while).
rights.portability: Get a machine-readable copy — admins can use Export data in the admin panel.
rights.object: Object to or limit a specific use.

privacy.contactBody: Write to {{email}}. We aim to reply within a month.
privacy.breachBody: If a breach is likely to affect you, we notify the authority within 72 hours and tell affected people without unnecessary delay.

admins.title: Manage Admins
admins.help: Invite people by email. They must register or sign in with that same address. Revoking turns access off but keeps the row for audit.
admins.emptyList: No admins yet. Invite someone above.
admins.inviteSent: Invitation email sent to {{email}}. They'll set a password via the link.
admins.inviteExisting: {{email}} already has an account. We sent a sign-in link so they know they've been granted access.
admins.inviteEmailFailed: {{email}} was added to the allowlist, but the email couldn't be sent: {{reason}}. Ask them to sign up manually — the account will work once they do.

cookie.body: We only use one cookie for admin sign-in. Readers get none. No tracking or ads.
